svg.aria-label: Traditional versus cloud-native database architecture. Traditionally each database node stores its data on its own local disk and replicates to other nodes. A cloud-native database separates compute from storage: stateless query nodes keep only a cache, and all data lives in a shared, replicated storage service such as object storage, so compute can be added or removed in minutes.
